package domain

import (
	"bytes"
	"crypto/sha256"
	"encoding/hex"
	"encoding/json"
	"io"
	"strings"
	"time"
	"unicode/utf8"
)

const (
	LearningPathCommandReplan = "REPLAN"
	LearningPathCommandNoGap  = "NO_GAP"

	MaximumLearningPathCommandPayloadBytes = 16 << 20
)

// LearningPathCommandCheckpoint is the immutable Student command boundary.
// Payload contains the exact request body; StudentID, LearningPathID and the
// planning/idempotency identity are bound by PayloadHash.
type LearningPathCommandCheckpoint struct {
	Command           string          `json:"command"`
	LearningPathID    string          `json:"learning_path_id"`
	PlanningRequestID string          `json:"planning_request_id"`
	IdempotencyKey    string          `json:"idempotency_key"`
	ExpectedVersion   int64           `json:"expected_version"`
	PlannedResultCode string          `json:"planned_result_code"`
	PlannedCourseID   string          `json:"planned_course_id,omitempty"`
	PlannedReused     bool            `json:"planned_reused"`
	PayloadHash       string          `json:"payload_hash"`
	Payload           json.RawMessage `json:"payload"`
	CheckpointedAt    time.Time       `json:"checkpointed_at"`
}

func NewLearningPathReplanCheckpoint(
	request CoursePlanRequest,
	command LearningPathReplan,
	checkpointedAt time.Time,
) (LearningPathCommandCheckpoint, error) {
	normalized, err := NormalizeLearningPathReplan(command)
	if err != nil || normalized.LearningPathID != strings.TrimSpace(request.LearningPathID) ||
		normalized.PlanningRequestID != strings.TrimSpace(request.ID) {
		return LearningPathCommandCheckpoint{}, ErrValidation
	}
	payload, err := json.Marshal(normalized)
	if err != nil {
		return LearningPathCommandCheckpoint{}, err
	}
	return newLearningPathCommandCheckpoint(request, LearningPathCommandReplan, normalized.ExpectedVersion, payload, checkpointedAt)
}

func NewLearningPathNoGapCheckpoint(
	request CoursePlanRequest,
	command LearningPathCompletion,
	checkpointedAt time.Time,
) (LearningPathCommandCheckpoint, error) {
	normalized, err := NormalizeLearningPathCompletion(command)
	if err != nil || normalized.LearningPathID != strings.TrimSpace(request.LearningPathID) ||
		normalized.PlanningRequestID != strings.TrimSpace(request.ID) {
		return LearningPathCommandCheckpoint{}, ErrValidation
	}
	payload, err := json.Marshal(normalized)
	if err != nil {
		return LearningPathCommandCheckpoint{}, err
	}
	return newLearningPathCommandCheckpoint(request, LearningPathCommandNoGap, normalized.ExpectedVersion, payload, checkpointedAt)
}

func NormalizeLearningPathCommandCheckpoint(
	input LearningPathCommandCheckpoint,
	studentID string,
	planningRequestID string,
	learningPathID string,
) (LearningPathCommandCheckpoint, error) {
	input.Command = strings.ToUpper(strings.TrimSpace(input.Command))
	input.LearningPathID = strings.TrimSpace(input.LearningPathID)
	input.PlanningRequestID = strings.TrimSpace(input.PlanningRequestID)
	input.IdempotencyKey = strings.TrimSpace(input.IdempotencyKey)
	input.PlannedResultCode = strings.TrimSpace(input.PlannedResultCode)
	input.PlannedCourseID = strings.TrimSpace(input.PlannedCourseID)
	input.PayloadHash = strings.TrimSpace(input.PayloadHash)
	input.CheckpointedAt = input.CheckpointedAt.UTC()
	studentID = strings.TrimSpace(studentID)
	planningRequestID = strings.TrimSpace(planningRequestID)
	learningPathID = strings.TrimSpace(learningPathID)
	digest, digestErr := hex.DecodeString(input.PayloadHash)
	if (input.Command != LearningPathCommandReplan && input.Command != LearningPathCommandNoGap) ||
		input.ExpectedVersion < 1 || digestErr != nil || len(digest) != sha256.Size || len(input.Payload) == 0 ||
		len(input.Payload) > MaximumLearningPathCommandPayloadBytes || input.CheckpointedAt.IsZero() ||
		!validCoursePlanUUID(studentID) || !validCoursePlanUUID(planningRequestID) || !validCoursePlanUUID(learningPathID) ||
		input.LearningPathID != learningPathID || input.PlanningRequestID != planningRequestID ||
		input.IdempotencyKey != planningRequestID {
		return LearningPathCommandCheckpoint{}, ErrValidation
	}
	if input.Command == LearningPathCommandReplan {
		if !validCoursePlanUUID(input.PlannedCourseID) ||
			(input.PlannedResultCode != CoursePlanResultCreated && input.PlannedResultCode != CoursePlanResultReused) ||
			input.PlannedReused != (input.PlannedResultCode == CoursePlanResultReused) {
			return LearningPathCommandCheckpoint{}, ErrValidation
		}
	} else if input.PlannedResultCode != CoursePlanResultNoGap || input.PlannedCourseID != "" || input.PlannedReused {
		return LearningPathCommandCheckpoint{}, ErrValidation
	}

	var payload []byte
	var err error
	switch input.Command {
	case LearningPathCommandReplan:
		var command LearningPathReplan
		if err = decodeStrictLearningPathCommand(input.Payload, &command); err == nil {
			command.LearningPathID = learningPathID
			command, err = NormalizeLearningPathReplan(command)
			if err == nil && command.PlanningRequestID == planningRequestID && command.ExpectedVersion == input.ExpectedVersion &&
				command.CourseID == input.PlannedCourseID {
				payload, err = json.Marshal(command)
			} else if err == nil {
				err = ErrValidation
			}
		}
	case LearningPathCommandNoGap:
		var command LearningPathCompletion
		if err = decodeStrictLearningPathCommand(input.Payload, &command); err == nil {
			command.LearningPathID = learningPathID
			command, err = NormalizeLearningPathCompletion(command)
			if err == nil && command.PlanningRequestID == planningRequestID && command.ExpectedVersion == input.ExpectedVersion {
				payload, err = json.Marshal(command)
			} else if err == nil {
				err = ErrValidation
			}
		}
	}
	if err != nil || learningPathCommandHash(
		studentID, planningRequestID, learningPathID, input.Command, input.ExpectedVersion,
		input.PlannedResultCode, input.PlannedCourseID, input.PlannedReused, payload,
	) != input.PayloadHash {
		return LearningPathCommandCheckpoint{}, ErrValidation
	}
	input.Payload = payload
	return input, nil
}

func DecodeLearningPathReplanCheckpoint(
	checkpoint LearningPathCommandCheckpoint,
	studentID string,
	planningRequestID string,
	learningPathID string,
) (LearningPathReplan, error) {
	checkpoint, err := NormalizeLearningPathCommandCheckpoint(checkpoint, studentID, planningRequestID, learningPathID)
	if err != nil || checkpoint.Command != LearningPathCommandReplan {
		return LearningPathReplan{}, ErrValidation
	}
	var command LearningPathReplan
	if err := json.Unmarshal(checkpoint.Payload, &command); err != nil {
		return LearningPathReplan{}, ErrValidation
	}
	command.LearningPathID = strings.TrimSpace(learningPathID)
	return NormalizeLearningPathReplan(command)
}

func DecodeLearningPathNoGapCheckpoint(
	checkpoint LearningPathCommandCheckpoint,
	studentID string,
	planningRequestID string,
	learningPathID string,
) (LearningPathCompletion, error) {
	checkpoint, err := NormalizeLearningPathCommandCheckpoint(checkpoint, studentID, planningRequestID, learningPathID)
	if err != nil || checkpoint.Command != LearningPathCommandNoGap {
		return LearningPathCompletion{}, ErrValidation
	}
	var command LearningPathCompletion
	if err := json.Unmarshal(checkpoint.Payload, &command); err != nil {
		return LearningPathCompletion{}, ErrValidation
	}
	command.LearningPathID = strings.TrimSpace(learningPathID)
	return NormalizeLearningPathCompletion(command)
}

func NormalizeLearningPathReplan(input LearningPathReplan) (LearningPathReplan, error) {
	input.Schema = strings.TrimSpace(input.Schema)
	input.LearningPathID = strings.TrimSpace(input.LearningPathID)
	input.PlanningRequestID = strings.TrimSpace(input.PlanningRequestID)
	input.CourseID = strings.TrimSpace(input.CourseID)
	input.GoalCode = normalizeCode(input.GoalCode)
	input.CourseFingerprint = strings.TrimSpace(input.CourseFingerprint)
	input.PlannerPolicyVersion = strings.TrimSpace(input.PlannerPolicyVersion)
	input.ReasonCode = normalizeCode(input.ReasonCode)
	input.ReasonSummary = strings.TrimSpace(input.ReasonSummary)
	items, err := normalizeLearningPathItems(input.Items, false)
	if err != nil || input.Schema != LearningPathReplanRequestSchema || !validCoursePlanUUID(input.LearningPathID) ||
		!validCoursePlanUUID(input.PlanningRequestID) || !validCoursePlanUUID(input.CourseID) || input.GoalCode == "" ||
		len(input.GoalCode) > 64 || input.CourseFingerprint == "" || len(input.CourseFingerprint) > 128 ||
		input.PlannerPolicyVersion == "" || len(input.PlannerPolicyVersion) > 64 || input.ReasonCode == "" ||
		len(input.ReasonCode) > 64 || input.ReasonSummary == "" || utf8.RuneCountInString(input.ReasonSummary) > 500 ||
		input.ExpectedVersion < 1 || len(items) < 1 || len(items) > 500 {
		return LearningPathReplan{}, ErrValidation
	}
	input.Items = items
	return input, nil
}

func NormalizeLearningPathCompletion(input LearningPathCompletion) (LearningPathCompletion, error) {
	input.Schema = strings.TrimSpace(input.Schema)
	input.LearningPathID = strings.TrimSpace(input.LearningPathID)
	input.PlanningRequestID = strings.TrimSpace(input.PlanningRequestID)
	input.GoalCode = normalizeCode(input.GoalCode)
	input.CourseID = strings.TrimSpace(input.CourseID)
	input.CourseFingerprint = strings.TrimSpace(input.CourseFingerprint)
	input.PlannerPolicyVersion = strings.TrimSpace(input.PlannerPolicyVersion)
	input.ReasonCode = normalizeCode(input.ReasonCode)
	input.ReasonSummary = strings.TrimSpace(input.ReasonSummary)
	if input.Schema != LearningPathNoGapRequestSchema || !validCoursePlanUUID(input.LearningPathID) ||
		!validCoursePlanUUID(input.PlanningRequestID) || !validCoursePlanUUID(input.CourseID) || input.GoalCode == "" ||
		len(input.GoalCode) > 64 || input.CourseFingerprint == "" || len(input.CourseFingerprint) > 128 ||
		input.PlannerPolicyVersion == "" || len(input.PlannerPolicyVersion) > 64 || input.ReasonCode != "mastery_no_gap" ||
		input.ReasonSummary == "" || utf8.RuneCountInString(input.ReasonSummary) > 500 || input.ExpectedVersion < 1 {
		return LearningPathCompletion{}, ErrValidation
	}
	return input, nil
}

func newLearningPathCommandCheckpoint(
	request CoursePlanRequest,
	command string,
	expectedVersion int64,
	payload []byte,
	checkpointedAt time.Time,
) (LearningPathCommandCheckpoint, error) {
	checkpoint := LearningPathCommandCheckpoint{
		Command: command, LearningPathID: strings.TrimSpace(request.LearningPathID),
		PlanningRequestID: strings.TrimSpace(request.ID), IdempotencyKey: strings.TrimSpace(request.ID),
		ExpectedVersion: expectedVersion, PlannedResultCode: strings.TrimSpace(request.ResultCode),
		PlannedCourseID: strings.TrimSpace(request.CourseID), PlannedReused: request.Reused,
		Payload:        append(json.RawMessage(nil), payload...),
		CheckpointedAt: checkpointedAt.UTC(),
	}
	checkpoint.PayloadHash = learningPathCommandHash(
		request.StudentID, request.ID, request.LearningPathID, checkpoint.Command, checkpoint.ExpectedVersion,
		checkpoint.PlannedResultCode, checkpoint.PlannedCourseID, checkpoint.PlannedReused, checkpoint.Payload,
	)
	return NormalizeLearningPathCommandCheckpoint(checkpoint, request.StudentID, request.ID, request.LearningPathID)
}

func learningPathCommandHash(
	studentID string,
	planningRequestID string,
	learningPathID string,
	command string,
	expectedVersion int64,
	plannedResultCode string,
	plannedCourseID string,
	plannedReused bool,
	payload []byte,
) string {
	canonical, _ := json.Marshal(struct {
		Schema            string          `json:"schema"`
		StudentID         string          `json:"student_id"`
		PlanningRequestID string          `json:"planning_request_id"`
		IdempotencyKey    string          `json:"idempotency_key"`
		LearningPathID    string          `json:"learning_path_id"`
		Command           string          `json:"command"`
		ExpectedVersion   int64           `json:"expected_version"`
		PlannedResultCode string          `json:"planned_result_code"`
		PlannedCourseID   string          `json:"planned_course_id,omitempty"`
		PlannedReused     bool            `json:"planned_reused"`
		Payload           json.RawMessage `json:"payload"`
	}{
		Schema: "planner-student-path-command-checkpoint.v1", StudentID: strings.TrimSpace(studentID),
		PlanningRequestID: strings.TrimSpace(planningRequestID), IdempotencyKey: strings.TrimSpace(planningRequestID),
		LearningPathID: strings.TrimSpace(learningPathID), Command: strings.ToUpper(strings.TrimSpace(command)),
		ExpectedVersion: expectedVersion, PlannedResultCode: strings.TrimSpace(plannedResultCode),
		PlannedCourseID: strings.TrimSpace(plannedCourseID), PlannedReused: plannedReused, Payload: payload,
	})
	digest := sha256.Sum256(canonical)
	return hex.EncodeToString(digest[:])
}

func decodeStrictLearningPathCommand(payload []byte, destination any) error {
	decoder := json.NewDecoder(bytes.NewReader(payload))
	decoder.DisallowUnknownFields()
	if err := decoder.Decode(destination); err != nil {
		return ErrValidation
	}
	if err := decoder.Decode(&struct{}{}); err != io.EOF {
		return ErrValidation
	}
	return nil
}
